_comment: Branch-protection ruleset for nanitics/nanitics main branch. Applied at cutover (Stage 2 Phase 1.8.4) via `jq 'del(._comment)' branch-protection-ruleset.json | gh api -X POST /repos/nanitics/nanitics/rulesets --input -`. Targets the default branch. Requires six status-check contexts: the two Python CI matrix legs we gate on (3.11 + 3.13), both CodeQL analyses, the docs build, and DCO. Admin role (RepositoryRole id 5) is the sole bypass actor — exercised by Phase 1.8.7 Case 3 of the smoke test. Enforcement is active. Required-PR rule blocks direct pushes to main; review approvals are not required (sole-maintainer setup).
name: main-protection
